title: City College: two design-build contracts of $2.0 million grew to $272.9 million

beats.text: City College hired a builder for 900,000 dollars of design. What did that contract become?

visual.label: XL Construction Corporation, latest stated amount

beats.text: This is a lead, not a finding.

visual.line: This is a lead, not a finding: a pattern in public records. This film says what the records show, what they do not show, and what would settle it.

beats.text: The first lead.
XL Construction’s contract began as schematic design, then grew through 21 change memos.
A design-build contract can be enlarged to the whole building without a second competition.

visual.line: enlarged to the whole building without a second competition

beats.text: Were the later phases priced against anyone? That’s the question.

beats.text: The second lead. Kitchell’s bond programme management contract started at 350,000 dollars.
And then?
47 times larger.
It grew by change memo, instead of by a new solicitation.
